summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for header/nav, hero, house scopes, Christmas pages, and about-video admin/API flows against public URL.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Homepage video (MP4) -> Home About playback
integration_issues.issue: Saving MP4 succeeds and URL persists, but frontend falls back to 'This film is currently unavailable.' (video fetch aborted in browser logs for mdn sample MP4). YouTube embed path works.

action_items: Investigate direct MP4 playback unavailability on homepage/admin preview (likely external media host/embed restriction or network policy); keep YouTube/Vimeo as fallback.
Main agent should retest About video playback with a production-hosted MP4 URL known to allow cross-origin streaming.
critical_code_review_comments: HouseNavigation desktop/mobile category menus, keyboard toggle (Enter/Escape), and route-close behavior are implemented and working with data-testid coverage.
Shop house filtering and strict category scoping are correctly enforced through query params; cross-house category combinations return empty without product leakage.
About-video backend canonicalization/validation is robust (auth boundaries, URL sanitization, no _id leak, persistence checks all passed).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows passed except direct MP4 playback availability)

seed_data_creation: Created/used TEST_video_customer_scope@example.com via API tests; no production data mutated. About-video setting restored to original empty state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used from frontend/.env. Verified: logo sizing (83 desktop / 73 mobile), Home nav removal desktop+mobile, four hover menus + submenu links, hero 4-product carousel + buy-now/cart + discover routing, featured jewelry-only with 5 cards and editorial images, home rows 6/5/6/4, /shop global 21 with ?house tabs, house pages category counts 3/6/4/4 with URL persistence, cross-house category empties, Christmas collection/gift-guide no cross-vertical leakage, responsive overflow clean at 320/768/1024/1440, multilingual nav/announcement strings update. Admin video: save/remove/YouTube embed works; direct MP4 playback unavailable in-browser in this env.
rca of the issue: RCA for MP4 playback gap: PUT /api/site/about-video stores canonical MP4 URL and GET returns it correctly; frontend receives URL and renders AboutVideo container, but browser network shows mp4 request aborted and component switches to fallback error state. This indicates integration/runtime media availability issue (external host/network/embed policy) rather than API validation/persistence bug. Repro: login admin -> Admin > Homepage tab -> save https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4 -> open home About section -> fallback text appears. Mitigation: use a company-controlled public MP4 endpoint with permissive streaming/CORS, or prefer YouTube/Vimeo embeds for guaranteed preview behavior.
